statements.chinese: 嗯，我认为Monica和Chandler如此般配的原因是...

statements.english: ... is because they were friends first
statements.chinese: 是因为他们最初是朋友。

were.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: Y'know ? So I asked myself ," Who are my friends ?"
statements.chinese: 你知道吗？于是我自问：“谁是我的朋友？”

statements.english: You and Phoebe , and I saw you first . So ..
statements.chinese: 你和Phoebe，但我先看到你的。所以……

statements.english: What are you saying ?
statements.chinese: 你在说什么？

statements.english: I'm saying maybe you and I crank it up a notch
statements.chinese: 我是说，也许你我可以更进一步。

statements.english: Y'know honey , umm , as uh , as flattered as I am that uh
statements.chinese: 亲爱的，呃，虽然我确实感到非常荣幸，那个，

statements.english: you saw me first
statements.chinese: 你先看见了我,

statements.english: uhh , I just , I-I don't think we should be cranking anything up
statements.chinese: 呃，我只是觉得我们不应该把任何东西调高。

statements.english: I'll treat you real nice
statements.chinese: 我会好好款待你的。

statements.english: Yeah , well , y'know umm ..
statements.chinese: 呃，这个嘛，你知道的...

statements.english: No honey , listen I think it's a great idea to become friends
statements.chinese: 亲爱的，听着，我觉得做朋友是个很棒的主意

statements.english: with someone before you date them
statements.chinese: 在与某人约会之前，

statements.english: but I think the way you do it is y'know you meet someone
statements.chinese: 但我认为你的做法是，你知道的，先遇到一个人，

statements.english: become their friend , build a foundation
statements.chinese: 成为他们的朋友，打下基础

statements.english: then you ask them out on a date
statements.chinese: 然后你约他们出去约会。

statements.english: Don't hit on your existing friends !
statements.chinese: 别对你现有的朋友下手！

statements.english: Won't-won't that take longer ?
statements.chinese: 这-这样不是会更耗时吗？

statements.english: Yeah . Yeah . Oh , but once you find it
statements.chinese: 是啊。没错。哦，不过一旦你找到了，

statements.english: ohh it's so worth the wait
statements.chinese: 这等待真是太值了。

statements.english: Yeah . I understand . I understand
statements.chinese: 是的。我明白。我明白。

statements.english: Man , I wish I saw Phoebe first !
statements.chinese: 唉，我真希望是我先遇到Phoebe的！

statements.english: Come here to me
statements.chinese: 过来我这里。

statements.english: No-no , you come here to me
statements.chinese: 不-不，你过来我这里。

statements.english: Hey Ross !
statements.chinese: 嘿 Ross！

statements.english: I brought reinforcements
statements.chinese: 我带了援军。

statements.english: Oh great ! What , you brought Joey ?
statements.chinese: 哦太好了！什么，你把Joey带来了？

statements.english: Well , I brought the next best thing
statements.chinese: 好吧，我带来了次优选择。

statements.english: Chandler ?! You brought Chandler ?!
statements.chinese: Chandler？！你把Chandler带来了？！

statements.english: The next best thing would be Monica !
statements.chinese: 次优人选非Monica莫属！

statements.english: Y'know , I would be offended , but Monica is freakishly strong , so ..
statements.chinese: 要知道，我本来会生气的，但Monica的力气大得吓人，所以...

statements.english: Look , I-I drew a sketch about how we're gonna do it . Okay
statements.chinese: 听着，我...我画了张草图来说明我们要怎么做。好吧

statements.english: Rach , that's you . That's the couch
statements.chinese: Rach，那是你。就是那张沙发。

statements.english: Whoa-oh , what's-what's that ?
statements.chinese: 哇哦，那-那是什么？

statements.english: Oh , that's me
statements.chinese: 哦，是我。

statements.english: You certainly think a lot of yourself
statements.chinese: 你可真是自视甚高。

statements.english: No ! That's-that's my arm !
statements.chinese: 不！那是——那是我的胳膊！

statements.english: Oh , I see . I thought you just really , really liked your new couch
statements.chinese: 哦，我明白了。我还以为你只是特别、特别喜欢你的新沙发呢。

statements.english: - Y'know what ? Just-just follow my lead . - Okay !
statements.chinese: 你知道吗？就——就跟着我来。 - 好的！

statements.english: Come on , Chandler
statements.chinese: 加油，Chandler。

statements.english: All right . Okay , here we go !
statements.chinese: 好了。好的，我们开始吧！

statements.english: All right , ready ?
statements.chinese: 好了，准备好了吗？

statements.english: Yeah
statements.chinese: 是啊。

statements.english: - Turn . - Okay
statements.chinese: - 转弯。- 好的。

statements.english: Turn ! Turn !
statements.chinese: 转啊！转啊！

statements.english: Okay , I don't think we can turn anymore !
statements.chinese: 好了，我觉得我们不能再转弯了！

statements.english: Ross , I don't , I just don't think it's going to fit
statements.chinese: Ross，我不觉得，我就是觉得这装不下。

statements.english: Oh yeah it will ! Come on , up ! Up-up-up !
statements.chinese: 噢当然会！加油，起来！快起来！起来！

statements.english: Up ! Yes ! Here we go ! Pivot !
statements.chinese: 起来！对！就这样！转！

statements.english: Pivot !
statements.chinese: 转向！

statements.english: Piv-ot !
statements.chinese: 枢轴！

statements.english: Piv-et !!
statements.chinese: Piv-et!!

statements.english: Piv-ett !!!
statements.chinese: Piv-ett!!!
